resources.string: Check phone streaming before connecting to wireless CarPlay. USB projection is not supported in this build.
User-reported test target: K80 · HyperOS 3.0.309.0 · CarWith 4.0.21-20261016 · 2024 ninth-generation Camry with wireless CarPlay.
CarWith matches the recorded version. Streaming and vehicle tests are still required.
CarWith differs from the recorded version or could not be read. Verify actual streaming; no downgrade is required.
The stream self-test requires enabled CarWith and Xiaomi CarLife components. Check their system app status first.

1. Park, disconnect other projection receivers, and run the stream self-test.
2. Confirm real video frames, then stop the self-test.
3. Select the receiver, open wireless CarPlay on the head unit, and connect manually.
4. Check video, touch, Amap navigation and NetEase Cloud Music audio.
5. Check navigation mixing, screen-off behavior and reconnecting. Export redacted diagnostics if a step fails.

An installed app may not be available in CarWith. App entry, login and audio need testing. This device combination has not passed vehicle acceptance.
